name: warroom-agent
description: Evidence-grounded competitive intelligence agent powered by Anakin search and DronaHQ strategic reasoning.

skills.name: Competitive Scan
skills.description: Runs live multi-competitor research and extracts evidence-grounded competitive signals.
examples: Scan Cashfree, Razorpay, and PayU for recent competitive signals.

skills.name: Response Simulator
skills.description: Generates evidence-grounded response options for product, sales, marketing, and strategy teams.
examples: How should PayFlow respond to Cashfree RiskShield?

skills.name: Ask WARROOM
skills.description: Answers competitive intelligence questions using supplied WARROOM signals and evidence.
examples: Why does Cashfree RiskShield matter to PayFlow?
